- Nested schema reference resolves via its own `$id`:

  `https://schemas.example.org/v1/billing/address.json`

  Acquisition: do not forward the `Authorization` header from `api.example.org` to `schemas.example.org`. The unauthenticated schema request returns 401, and no schema-host credentials are approved, so this reference is inaccessible and excluded from the resolved inventory.

- Document-level response reference resolves against the OpenAPI document URL:

  `https://api.example.org/spec/responses.json#/NotFound`

  Acquisition: fetch `https://api.example.org/spec/responses.json` (the fragment is resolved locally) using the approved authorization mechanism for `api.example.org`, subject to the normal HTTPS and redirect checks.

The nested `$id` is resolved against the enclosing schema identifier: `billing/` becomes `https://schemas.example.org/v1/billing/`; it therefore does not affect the separate document-level response reference.
